_comment: Hand-maintained supplement to stretchy-chars.json, which is GENERATED from
MathML's operator dictionary and must not be edited.  Keyed by codepoint,
because glyph names vary between fonts and families while the character
'add' -- characters that take size cuts although the dictionary does not
list them.  Two reasons recur: MathML lists a different SPELLING of the same
thing (2215 DIVISION SLASH but not the ASCII 002F the fonts use; 02DC SMALL
TILDE but not 0303 COMBINING TILDE, and this project records accents as
combining marks), or it omits the character altogether.  Each entry says
what was actually seen in a font, so the claim can be rechecked.
'composed' -- characters the dictionary DOES list as stretchy, but which a
font builds by stacking pieces rather than by holding several sizes.  They
have no ladder to rank; the note is so that a report showing 'one cut plus
pieces' is not read as a font missing its cuts.
After editing, rerun the size report: make <font>.gpm.sizes

add.U+002F: SOLIDUS -- s1..s4 in stix-mathex; MathML lists 2215 DIVISION SLASH and 2044 FRACTION SLASH, not the ASCII one the fonts use
add.U+005C: REVERSE SOLIDUS -- s1..s4 in stix-mathex, backslashbig..Bigg in the built-in table; MathML lists no spelling of it (2216 SET MINUS is absent too)
add.U+29F8: BIG SOLIDUS -- base + s1 in stix-mathex
add.U+29F9: BIG REVERSE SOLIDUS -- base + s1 in stix-mathex
add.U+0303: COMBINING TILDE -- six cuts in stix-mathit and -bold; MathML lists only its spacing form 02DC
add.U+030C: COMBINING CARON -- six cuts in stix-mathit and -bold; MathML lists only its spacing form 02C7
add.U+0361: COMBINING DOUBLE INVERTED BREVE -- arcwide/wider/widest in the built-in table; MathML lists no spelling of it
add.U+2140: DOUBLE-STRUCK N-ARY SUMMATION -- base + s1 in stix-mathex; an n-ary operator, so it takes the text/display pair like 2211, but MathML lists only the plain summation

composed.U+2190: LEFT ARROW -- stix-mathsf holds the base and an extension piece, no size cuts
composed.U+21D0: LEFT DOUBLE ARROW -- likewise in stix-mathsf
composed.U+21D1: UPWARDS DOUBLE ARROW -- likewise in stix-mathsf
composed.U+21DA: LEFTWARDS TRIPLE ARROW -- likewise in stix-mathsf
composed.U+27F0: UPWARDS QUADRUPLE ARROW -- likewise in stix-mathsf
composed.U+290A: UPWARDS TRIPLE ARROW -- likewise in stix-mathsf
composed.U+23DC: TOP PARENTHESIS -- stix-mathit builds it from l/r halves and a middle
composed.U+23DE: TOP CURLY BRACKET -- likewise, plus an extension

_considered: Looked at and deliberately left out, from a harvest of all 226 glyphs2u lua
tables (111 base codepoints carry a selector there, 41 were outside both
lists).  Rare or a different phenomenon; revisit if a font makes them matter:
25DC..25DF  quadrant circular arcs, nine cuts each in latxfont -- not sizes
256D..2570  box-drawing arcs, mtpro2
25CB 25CF   white/black circle, FIFTEEN selectors each in latxfont, and the
triangles, square, diamond, star, pentagram beside them: these
are enclosures, drawn at whatever size the thing they encircle
needs, not a ladder of cuts of one character.  A particular size
can double as an n-ary operator, but that is a per-SIZE judgement
and this file keys on the character alone.
0026 2217   ampersand, asterisk operator (mtpro2)
2A3F 2295 2297 2299  ladders mtpro2 continues across sibling fonts, starting
at FE03/FE04 rather than FE01
Two entries look like table errors rather than missing characters, left
uncorrected for now:
23D0 FE01   'barexbigx' in public/newtx/txex-bar.lua -- 23D0 IS the vertical
line extension, an assembly piece, and a piece has no sizes
2225 FE01/FE02  'bigparallel'/'hugeparallel' in public/stmaryrd/stmary10.lua
-- stmaryrd draws these as tall double bars, i.e. delimiters, so
2016 DOUBLE VERTICAL LINE (already listed by MathML as stretchy,
fence) is the base, not 2225 PARALLEL TO, which is a relation
